provenance.source: THIN-SKIN-GUITAR-BUILD-ESTIMATE-1 sprint; all three components are engineering estimates with no owner-confirmation artifact.

notes: Burden ($2.15/hr) is an engineering estimate: ~$6,000 booth capital (enclosure, exhaust, make-up air, lighting) over a 7-year life at an assumed 400 occupancy-hours/year = 2,800 hours, giving $2.14/hr, rounded to $2.15. Not owner-confirmed.
Electricity ($0.22/hr) = 2.2 kW x load_factor 0.85 x $0.12/kWh. Load factor 0.85 assumes the exhaust fan runs essentially continuously whenever the booth is occupied.
Consumables ($1.85/hr) covers intake and exhaust filters plus booth wall coating. Masking, tack cloth, and solvent are estimate material inputs, not booth consumables, so they are not counted twice.
equipment_hour_rate ($4.22/hr) is a true-cost rate: burden 2.15 + electricity 0.22 + consumables 1.85. COST input, not a billing rate.
Excludes any regulatory, permitting, or VOC-compliance cost. Those are overhead and belong to GUITAR-FULL-UNIT-COST-1, not to this direct-cost layer.
Record status is 'draft' because every component is an unconfirmed engineering estimate.
